## ✅ RECOMMENDED EVENTS

### 1. **Suitcase Rummage**
- **Date & Time:** Sunday, May 17, 2026 | 12:00 PM – 5:00 PM
- **Location:** Reddacliffe Place (top of Queen Street Mall), Brisbane City
- **Cost:** $30 + fees (vendor stalls); free to browse
- **URL:** https://events.humanitix.com/brisbane-meanjin-may-17th-2026
- **Organizer:** Suitcase Rummage
- **Why it fits:** Community-oriented, grassroots market with vintage goods, handmade items, art, records, and books. Natural conversation between vendors and browsers. Authentic local culture, not corporate.
